voices.name: Young upbeat (F)
voices.prompt: A young American woman in her early twenties with a bright, high-energy voice. Fast, punchy delivery like a viral short-form video creator, crisp consonants and confident upward inflection.

voices.name: Warm storyteller (F)
voices.prompt: A woman in her late twenties with a warm, slightly husky voice. Slow, intimate delivery as if telling a secret to one person, a soft laugh at the edges of her words.

voices.name: Crisp British (F)
voices.prompt: A British woman in her thirties with a crisp, precise accent. Measured and slightly sardonic, dry wit, very clean articulation.

voices.name: Whisper ASMR (F)
voices.prompt: A soft, breathy female voice speaking very close to the microphone in an intimate near-whisper. Calm, slow and airy.

voices.name: Authoritative (F)
voices.prompt: A polished woman in her forties with a neutral broadcast American accent. Authoritative, low and deliberate, like a documentary narrator.

voices.name: Hype trailer (M)
voices.prompt: A deep male voice in his thirties with cinematic trailer delivery. Punchy and dramatic, heavy emphasis on stressed words, a slight gravel in the low end.

voices.name: Friendly explainer (M)
voices.prompt: A friendly American man in his late twenties. Conversational and upbeat, natural pacing, like a tech YouTuber explaining something exciting to a friend.

voices.name: Raspy mature (M)
voices.prompt: A mature man in his fifties with a raspy, gravelly voice. Slow and deliberate, low pitch, weathered and calm.

voices.name: Deadpan (M)
voices.prompt: A dry, deadpan male voice with flat intonation and comic timing. Understated, low energy, never sounds excited.

voices.name: Young Indian English (M)
voices.prompt: A young Indian man in his early twenties speaking English with a natural urban Indian accent. Casual, quick and playful.

models.notes: Invent a voice from a written description. Best English quality.
